Name: SV i18n Comment Namer
Author: darthalex2014
Description:
[size=4][b]Also check [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28796]SV i18n Translation Merger[/url]
[b]Also check [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21858]SV i18n Converter Tools[/url]
[b]Also check [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29116]XNB to CP Converter (For Dialogs mods)[/url][b]

[center] SV i18n Comment Namer[/center][/b][/size][b][size=3][center]Make your mod translation-friendly! This mod automatically adds NPC names to dialogue lines in your i18n files, making it easier for translators to work with.[/center][/size][/b][center][b][size=3]This tool helps Stardew Valley modders create translation-friendly i18n files by automatically adding comments that identify which character or game element is associated with each text entry.[/size][/b][/center][size=3][b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b][u]Customizable Commenting:[/u][/b] Choose which types of i18n entries to comment using the checkboxes below:[list]
[*][b]Include Events:[/b] Adds comments to lines using common event commands like [b][u]speak[/u][/b], [b][u]dialogue[/u][/b], [b][u]textAboveHead[/u][/b], and [b][u]dialogueWarpOut[/u][/b].
[*][b][u]Include message:[/u][/b] Adds "[b][u]//message[/u][/b]" comments to lines using the message
 command.[*][b][u]Include Characters/Dialogue/:[/u][/b] Automatically detects and comments dialogue lines within [b][u]Characters/Dialogue/[/u][/b]
 blocks, even if those blocks are formatted across multiple lines.[*][b][u]Include Strings/schedules/:[/u][/b] Automatically detects and comments text entries within [b][u]Strings/schedules/[/u][/b]
 blocks, useful for schedule-related text.[/list]
[/list][list][*][b][u]Prevent Duplicate Comments:[/u][/b] The "[b][u]Don't add comments to lines with existing comments[/u][/b]" option ensures the tool won't add redundant comments to lines that already have them (starting with "//").
[/list][/size][b][size=3]This makes your i18n files easier to understand and translate, leading to a better experience for international players!
[/size][/b]
[size=3][b]How to Use:[/b]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Click "[b][u]Select Folder[/u][/b]" and choose the folder that contains your mod's [b][u]content.json[/u][/b] file. Make sure this folder also [b][u]contains the i18n[/u][/b] folder with your [b][u]default.json[/u][/b] file.[/size]
[*][size=3]Select the types of i18n entries you want to comment using the checkboxes.[/size]
[*][size=3]The program will automatically process your files and create a new file named [b][u]default_with_comments.json[/u][/b] in the i18n folder.[/size]
[/list][size=3]That's it! Your new [b][u]default_with_comments.json[/u][/b] file will have helpful comments that make translation and organization easier.[/size]

[b][size=3]Planned Features:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][s]\"{{i18n:key | text}}\" (lines where the | separator is used[/s]) Done
[*][s]\"{{i18n:key{{Random: ...}}}}\"[/s]  Done
[*][s]\"{{i18n:key}}!\" (the ! sign after {{i18n:key}})[/s] Done
[*][s]\"{{i18n:key}}.\" (the . sign after {{i18n:key}})[/s] Done
[/list]
[size=3][b]Known cases that are not commented:[/b][/size][list]
[*]question fork1 and quickQuestion and question null (It's better to comment these lines manually, as different mod authors use them differently)
[*]\"$q number null #{{i18n:key}}#$r
[*]\"{{i18n:key}}#$b# (when #$b# is after {{i18n:key}})
[*]"i18n_name": "{{i18n:key}}\" (when {{i18n:key}} is at the beginning of the event)
[*]\"/{{i18n:key}}\" (extra /, most likely an error in the mods)
[*][u][b]"key" :[/b][/u]
[/list]
